revisions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one transparent COSYWORLD character sprite, ADA, PLAIN clothing, seated defensive brace/guard pose.
Input image 1 is the authoritative identity, outfit and wheelchair reference: canonical ada.png. Preserve Ada's exact young freckled face, warm fair skin, large brown eyes, tousled short white bob, compact build, lavender rolled-sleeve blouse, plain PURPLE neckerchief tied in its original knot, dark-purple high-waisted trousers, brown leather suspenders with brass fittings, cream wool socks and dark lace-up boots.

ADA MUST REMAIN SEATED in her exact complete wooden-and-brass wheelchair. Preserve its wood frame, brown upholstered seat/back, brass rims and supports, large rear wheels with wooden spokes and dark tires, small front casters, curved armrests and full front footplate. The two large wheels and the casters stay upright and grounded on a common invisible plane, with the far wheel naturally occluded as in the reference. Both feet remain supported on the footplate. No standing, rising from the seat, levitation, tipping, wheelies, missing chair parts or extra wheels. Preserve the original chair's perspective, proportions and construction.

Change only her upper-body pose to a stable defensive guard facing RIGHT. She braces in the seat, leaning forward slightly within the stable chair, with both forearms raised protectively across chest and near her face; one empty hand beside the cheek and the other below it across the upper chest. Keep her eyes OPEN and alert toward the opponent off canvas right, lips closed or gently parted in concentration. This is anticipation of impact, not a strike, not an injury, not a frightened recoil. Both hands are empty with natural fingers and normal anatomy. Keep her face unobscured, knees bent naturally in the seated position, and the wheelchair fully visible.
Output exactly 1024 x 1536 RGBA pixels with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. Remove the source's colored vignette, diffuse aura, floor and ground shadow completely. Every gap around and within the silhouette must be transparent, including between limbs and equipment. The figure and clothing are opaque, with clean antialiased outline edges; no translucent body, grey matte, colored fringe, halo, checkerboard texture or painted background. Full figure fully visible, around 40 pixels clear above the highest point, at least 50 pixels on both sides, and approximately 60–80 pixels below the soles/contact points (near 95% canvas height). Preserve a readable tall full-body scale; no cropped hair, boots or accessories. Painted gouache-and-ink style matching the reference, fine ink outlines, tactile aged cloth and warm natural materials. No added text, logos, impact flashes, extra props, scenery or watermark.
For this seated character, keep the full chair-and-person silhouette within the canvas, wheels/footplate near 95% canvas height, and a little extra headroom is acceptable because her seated proportions must remain natural.

revisions.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one full-figure transparent COSYWORLD PIP (asset ID moth) defensive guard / brace sprite.
Input image 1 is the authoritative identity, anatomy, outfit and wing-pattern reference: moth.png. Pip is the exact anthropomorphic moth from this painting: cream furry head and ruff, huge glossy dark amber-brown eyes, fine little mouth, two tall FEATHERY antennae, and two broad moth wings with the existing grey-brown, ivory and ochre eye-spot patterns. Keep the ochre waistcoat with brass buttons, ivory rolled sleeves, blue-grey spotted neck bow/scarf, diagonal brown leather satchel and its straps, pocket watch/chain, dark loose trousers and brown boots.
Change the pose to a stable grounded defensive guard facing LEFT. Both feet planted in a slight stagger, knees softly bent, weight centered. Raise both EMPTY hands and forearms in front of upper chest and beside the face to brace for an incoming impact from off canvas LEFT. Open alert eyes looking LEFT. No punch, weapon, attack, recoil, injury, closed eyes or falling. Keep face and antennae visible.
Exactly TWO arms with TWO hands and TWO legs with TWO boots. The wings sit folded closer behind his back for a compact guard silhouette, preserving the same patterned surfaces; they remain broad moth wings, never extra arms, sleeves, tails, feathers or insect legs. Keep both antennae wholly visible with a clear gap around their tips. Preserve all identity, build, texture, clothes and accessories. Hands are empty; satchel/watch remain attached, not held as weapons.
Output EXACT 1024 x 1536 RGBA, full silhouette from antenna tips to boot soles, about 40 pixels of transparent clearance above, at least 50 pixels on both sides, soles around y=1460 with clear space beneath. The entire character remains on canvas. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background: alpha0 outside the subject and in every gap between limbs, antennae and wings; no source vignette, diffuse aura, floor or ground shadow. Subject interiors opaque with clean antialiased edges. Same painted gouache-and-ink illustration style, warm tactile natural materials and fine dark outlines. No added text, scenery, logos, effects, checkerboard pattern or watermark.
revisions.decision: Revised once for safer clearance around top antenna, right wing and lowest boot.
